title: Update Advancement Quests
description: A datapack/mod that adds new advancements to complete for the new content of Minecraft Updates [Updated for 26.2]
body:
**Adds guided quest-style advancements for new Minecraft Java Edition updates.**

Minecraft adds new content but rarely commits to more advancements. This fills that empty knowledge gap and achieving thirst with a quest-like tree designed to walk you through new content in-game.

Rather than stumbling across things by accident or reaching for the wiki, each advancement acts as a guide and objective from various new biomes, blocks, crafting and even little notable changes

---

## How It Works

A new tab appears in your Advancements screen for each supported update. Advancements are ordered to form a path based on discovery. Completely vanilla friendly, no rewards or gameplay changes.

---

### Currently covered content
May Contain spoilers

<details>
<summary>26.2 - Chaos Cubed</summary>

- **Sulfur Caves** - enter the sulfur caves biome

- **Cinnabar** - collect cinnabar, then craft its stairs/slab/wall, polished set, brick set, and chiseled variant

- **Sulfur** - collect sulfur, then craft its stairs/slab/wall, polished set, brick set, and chiseled variant

- **Sulfur Spike** - pick up a sulfur spike from the cave floor or ceiling

- **Potent Sulfur** - pick up potent sulfur from a water pool in the sulfur caves

- **Sulfur Cube** - place a block inside a cube, shear it back out, kill an empty cube and watch it split, feed a slimeball to a small cube to grow it, bucket a large cube, punch an empty cube, and trigger all twelve block archetypes

- **Music Disc** - obtain the Bounce disc from a mineshaft chest in the sulfur caves

- **Geyser** - get launched into the air by an erupting potent sulfur geyser

- **Sulfur Spring** - find a sulfur spring on the surface above the sulfur caves

</details>

---

## Recommended

Use with [**Modern Advancements Screen**](https://modrinth.com/mod/modern-advancement-screen) for a much better and more clear experience. Full-screen layout, zoom controls, search, tracking with popups and other useful functions.

Modern Advancements Screen includes a guide feature on the Advancements with useful information to unlock it

---

## Installation

Two versions are available, pick whichever suits your setup

**Datapack (`.zip`)** - no mod loader required
1. Place the `.zip` in your world's `datapacks` folder (`saves/<world name>/datapacks/`)
2. Run `/reload` in-game, or re-load into the world
3. Open your Advancements screen (`L`) - a new tab will appear

**Mod (`.jar`)** - requires [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/)
1. Place the `.jar` in your `mods` folder
2. Launch the game as normal
3. Advancements are applied globally across all worlds automatically

*It is recommended for clients to have the mod if the server is using it as the mod contains translation files unlike the datapack of raw text*
